Repaired feed pagination by adding a stable `(createdAt, id)` ordering and keyset cursor, preserving the snapshot across resumed pages, and filtering out rows inserted after that snapshot. The cursor codec now supports the new format and resumes legacy `v1` links using their timestamp-only semantics.

Validation passed: `./run_visible_tests.sh` and `java -cp out PaginationProbe`.
